about: Pets with lives of their own (Hit List #15), drawn by seed with no model (dungeon/life/pets.py). kinds: lifespans in years, the eras a kind is drawn in, how common it is, and what it needs (walks, a minder while the owner is away, a vet). 'vet' entries are reasons for a yearly checkup ('old': only for an old pet). Each list entry names the kinds it suits (or 'any') and the eras (or 'any'). Sentences use {pet} for the pet's name. 'sick' texts follow 'is poorly with'; 'vet' texts follow 'for'; 'photos' describe only what the picture shows (visible things, no injuries; 'out': taken away from home, so never for a moment at home) and carry a first-person caption. 'townsfolk' gives each townsperson pet of life_details.json a kind and a looks line; a null kind is an animal they feed or befriend but do not keep.
